title: A Hummingbird's Body Chilled to 38°F Overnight and It Lived

scenes.text: A hummingbird chills to near freezing every night.
In the Andes, one species dropped from about 104°F to 38°F.
Its heart slowed from up to 1,200 beats a minute to under 100.
It stayed in this deep sleep for hours.
Then it shivered itself warm again, up to half an hour.
The coldest body of any bird or non-hibernating mammal.

description:
In the high Andes, a black metaltail hummingbird cooled its body from about 104°F to about 38°F overnight, the lowest temperature reported for a bird or non-hibernating mammal.
Its heart slowed from up to 1,200 beats a minute to under 100.
Could you survive a night like that?
first_comment: What is the coldest night you have survived?
